hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read fp; case "$fp" in *.pbxproj|*.xcodeproj/*) echo 'Blocked: never edit the Xcode project file directly for routine file additions. If a project setting/capability truly requires it, write a numbered ADR and ask the user to rerun with ALLOW_XCODEPROJ_CHANGE=1.' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read fp; case "$fp" in *.swift) swiftformat "$fp" --quiet 2>/dev/null; swiftlint lint --path "$fp" --quiet 2>/dev/null | head -20;; esac; exit 0; }
